verdict.rationale: The Comptroller documents one sanctioned third-party channel: franchise reports may be submitted electronically through approved tax preparation provider software. That is an authorized-provider rail, but it rests on a single thin mention and nothing shows how a provider is authorized to act for a specific company. Missing for 10: documented designee, power-of-attorney or representative authorization, how providers are approved and listed, delegated access within eSystems/Webfile, and coverage beyond franchise tax.
